# grouper_membership (Resource)

Manages a single direct (immediate) membership of a subject in a Grouper group. Only the one membership represented by this resource is managed; other members of the group are never added or removed. All identity attributes are immutable (changing any forces replacement).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grouper_group" "aws_admins" {
  name         = "example:apps:myteam:example:aws-admins"
  display_name = "AWS Administrators"
}

# One resource per direct membership. Use for_each to manage a set of members
# without affecting anyone added to the group by other means.
resource "grouper_membership" "aws_admins" {
  for_each = toset([
    "abc123",
    "xyz456",
  ])

  group_name = grouper_group.aws_admins.name
  subject_id = each.value
}

# Import format: <group_name>/<subject_source_id>/<subject_id>
#   terraform import 'grouper_membership.aws_admins["abc123"]' \
#     'example:apps:myteam:example:aws-admins/ldap/abc123'
#
# If the source is unknown/omitted, leave it empty:
#   .../example:aws-admins//abc123
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_name` (String) Full colon-delimited name of the group. Changing this forces replacement.
- `subject_id` (String) Identifier of the subject to add. May be the subject's id or a login identifier such as a username or NetID (Grouper resolves either). Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `subject_source_id` (String) Subject source id (e.g. the LDAP source). Optional; supply it to disambiguate when the same id exists in multiple sources. Populated with the resolved source after apply. Changing an explicitly-set value forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Deterministic identifier: "<group_name>/<subject_source_id>/<subject_id>".
- `membership_type` (String) Membership type managed by this resource. Always "immediate" (direct).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <group_name>/<subject_source_id>/<subject_id>
terraform import grouper_membership.example 'example:apps:myteam:aws-admins/sourceId/abc123'

# The source component may be empty if unknown:
terraform import grouper_membership.example 'example:apps:myteam:aws-admins//abc123'
```
